maria (eng): Quick question about API auth edgecases — what should endpoints return when `Authorization: Bearer <key>` is valid but `X-Project-ID` header is missing? We still have older clients that only use org-scoped keys.
kevin (platform): Short answer: it depends. Missing required header -> 400. Invalid creds -> 401. Valid key but no access to the resolved project -> 403. We should be explicit in the spec.
sam (sec): +1. Keep semantics consistent across endpoints. Missing required headers = 400 (invalid_request). Auth failures = 401. Authorization failures = 403.
kevin (platform): Also need to handle key rotation gracefully: accept previous key for a short grace window, but don't leak which key matched in responses.
ryan (eng): FWIW we saw a regression on streaming where proxy returned an HTML 401 page. We must standardize JSON error bodies for all endpoints (including streaming control messages).
infra-bot: deploy: auth-middleware v2 rolled out to canary in us-east-1 (rollout_id=rl-2026-03-16-15) :white_check_mark:
kevin (platform): Proposal for bodies: missing header -> 400 + {"error":"invalid_request","reason":"missing_header","header":"X-Project-ID"}.
maria (eng): Nice. Follow-ups: 1) Backcompat: map org-scoped tokens to default project if server config allows. 2) Rotation: how do we indicate which key was used without leaking? 3) Telemetry: what fields do we include?
sam (sec): 1) Yes, map org-key -> default project only when `ALLOW_ORG_TO_DEFAULT=true` and document it. 2) Never expose which key matched in responses; in logs send an obfuscated key id (e.g., `kid: k_***e3`). 3) Telemetry should include outcome (accepted/denied), failure_reason, resolved_org_id, resolved_project_id (if any), auth_method (e.g., bearer, x-api-key) — but never the raw token.
kevin (platform): Implementation note: middleware will check headers in canonical order: `X-API-Key`, `Authorization: Bearer`, `X-Org-Key`. We'll emit a single `auth_method` in logs. Also, only set `WWW-Authenticate` on 401 responses: `Bearer realm=\"redwood\", error=\"invalid_token\"`.
maria (eng): Can we agree on exact JSON examples so I can update the API contract? Pasting examples below.
maria (eng): ```json
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error":"invalid_request",
  "reason":"missing_header",
  "header":"X-Project-ID",
  "message":"Project header required for this endpoint"
}
```
maria (eng): ```json
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm=\"redwood\", error=\"invalid_token\"
{
  "error":"unauthenticated",
  "reason":"invalid_token",
  "message":"Invalid API key"
}
```
kevin (platform): LGTM. I'll add these to the API spec and open a PR to update middleware behavior + tests. Also adding a per-customer flag `fallback_to_org_default`.
maria (eng): Tagging @legal for doc wording about logging (no raw tokens) and @support for changelog comms.
support-bot: reminder: update customer-facing changelog for auth behavior changes and rotation window.
maria (eng): I'll file the PR and link it here when ready.
kevin (platform): Please link PR; will do a quick review.
